resource.title: Spina Bifida home monitoring and autonomic/GI/GU support plan
resource.description: Home-assisted monitoring plan for Spina Bifida with neurogenic bladder/bowel, mobility support, hydration, GI symptoms, and UTI risk surveillance.

detail.description: Track vomiting, reduced intake, bowel routine changes, urinary symptoms, fever, and fatigue

Continue bowel regimen and monitor constipation or diarrhea
